title: Editing & Proofreading
description: Turn rough drafts into clean, confident, mistake-free prose.

prompts.text: Give a line-by-line critique with fixes for a draft about a blog draft with run-on sentences.
Rewrite a draft about to match an authoritative but kind tone meeting notes that miss the decisions. Keep it clear, specific, and ready to use.
Act as a brand journalist. Produce a style-consistency checklist for editing a newsletter draft with mixed audiences, then wrap up with one short paragraph of key takeaways.
Proofread and correct grammar in a passage about a blog draft with run-on sentences. Format the answer with a short intro, numbered steps, and a closing tip.
I’m working on a persuasive essay with weak transitions. Create a pre-publish quality checklist for it and explain your reasoning as you go.
